## Verdict

Clean documentation reframe — the new "Local & CI Companion" narrative, two-audience intro, Surface column, flows-before-install order, and explicit default-flow header make the four capabilities visible in the first screen without touching procedural content.

## Notes

- **Scope is correct.** Only `skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md` changes; the vendored `.agents/skills/ai-diff-reviewer/**` snapshot is untouched (Rule #14 / auto-release Step 3.5).
- **Procedural body preserved.** Diff hunks stop before Step 0; Trust boundary, Steps 0–5, and Notes are unchanged. First-time bootstrap remains documented in Step 2.5 after the intro trailer was removed.
- **Parity content retained.** The byte-identical `prompt.md` / prompt-sync invariant note moved into the new **Version parity** blurb; the compressed Flow B paragraph still states the Step 5 handoff condition for `prompt-extension-file`.
- **Security surface unchanged.** `allowed-tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob` retained; install guidance stays on `npx skills add` (no `curl | sh`); no new write-capable tools without a trust-boundary section.
- **Second commit** correctly softens the intro parity bullet so it does not overclaim extension-file wiring before the Flow B section.
- Frontmatter `description` remains above the ~1024-character host cap that some skill loaders apply (pre-existing length; this PR only inserts " & CI"). Full trigger catalogue still lives under **Activation**, so routing via the body is intact. Tightening the description is optional follow-up, not a merge blocker.

## Release decision

**Recommendation:** approve
